g.text: Mat layout 53 × 35 in: lines every 12 in and a dot every 6 in, for drawing a cutting table

10 × 7 dots, 8 mm, every 6 in from the top-left corner and then the far edge, with lines every 12 in. Project this through a calibration set on the four corners of the mat, draw along the lines, stick a dot in the middle of each target.
Then check with a tape, measuring to the middle of the lines: 12 in between lines, 53 in across, 35 in down, and corner to corner 63.514 in (1613.25 mm). Any dot is also 6 in from its neighbours.
